environment.description: ECS Fargate service deployed in isolated subnet (10.0.128.0/25) within a dedicated VPC (10.0.128.0/24). The service is ONLY accessible through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that restricts principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/AlertConsumerInvokerRole. The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. The subnet's route table contains only the local route (10.0.128.0/24 local). Security group sg-0xdeadbeef attached to the ENI allows inbound TCP/8080 only from the VPCE prefix list (pl-0abc123). Additionally, the ECS task role has a permissions boundary that denies sts:AssumeRole and restricts network egress via a VPC endpoint policy on the Secrets Manager endpoint limiting access to the specific secret ARNs needed. The Kafka topic has ACL restricting produce to a single IAM role not available to external accounts.

config.network: Isolated subnet 10.0.128.0/25, no IGW, no NAT, no peering, route table: local only
config.privatelink: Interface endpoint vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890, endpoint policy: Allow only arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/AlertConsumerInvokerRole
config.security_group: sg-0xdeadbeef: inbound TCP/8080 from pl-0abc123 (VPCE prefix list) only
config.task_role_boundary: Permissions boundary denying sts:AssumeRole, ec2:*, and restricting secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to specific ARNs
config.dns: Private hosted zone, no public DNS resolution
